title: Home templates as data: two or three vetted home pages built from includes
description:
Outcome: A tenant picks a home template instead of writing a home page: each template is a Markus page with ::include blocks (latest stories, findings by section, talking now, concepts) from the block catalogue. MoM's pages/home.md is the model for the 'publication' template; a quieter 'blog' template serves Pilobolus-like sites. Blocks read from indexes (PPY-7f1e54), never from whole-corpus files.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): src/papyrus_content/projection/standard (home page and includes), new templates under src/papyrus_content/starter/home/, docs/home-page.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/home-templates.feature):
Scenario: Choosing a template changes the home page only
    Given "alpha" switches from "publication" to "blog"
    When the home page is projected
    Then it uses the blog template and no other page changed

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-1252ce. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Golden renders of each template with two brand packs.
Rollout: Releasable alone.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a template depends on a block that reads the whole corpus. Mitigation: blocked by PPY-7f1e54 for any References block.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
